name: ai-silo-gtm-loop
description: Agentic GTM loop for the AI silo diagnostic (hackathon)

scripts.test:page: cd site && npm install && SITE_URL=https://ai-silo-check.vercel.app node build.js && cd .. && node tests/page-e2e.js
scripts.test:x-length: T=$(mktemp -d) && (cd $T && npm init -y >/dev/null && npm i twitter-text@3.1.0 --silent) && TT_DIR=$T node tests/x-length.check.js
